page: Microsoft Azure E128-64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine designed for memory-intensive enterprise software and large in-memory databases. Hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 64 dedicated x86_64 virtual CPUs sourced from 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz. It features 1024 GB of total system RAM, establishing an expansive 16 GB of memory per vCPU ratio, supported by a 260 MB L3 cache.

The compute subsystem incorporates advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8, facilitating accelerated matrix math and cryptographic tasks. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate top-tier uncached memory bandwidth, reaching 391.59 GB/sec on large-block reads and 171.9 GB/sec on large-block writes. Multiprocessor throughput is corroborated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 20,700 and top-tier results in PassMark database operations and static web throughput.

A notable configuration tradeoff is the absence of bundled local ephemeral storage, meaning all persistent and scratch input/output relies entirely on network-attached Premium Storage disks. Similarly, the instance does not include bundled public IPv4 addresses or dedicated hardware GPUs. However, the constrained core count within a high-memory chassis offers favorable licensing cost efficiency for software billed on a per-core basis that still demands substantial memory capacity.

The Azure E128-64s_v6 is best suited for memory-bound relational databases, large-scale Redis caching layers, in-memory analytics engines, and CPU-intensive enterprise workloads requiring dense memory footprints.
description: Microsoft Azure E128-64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for memory-dense enterprise applications. Powered by a 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V, it delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores and 1024 GB of system memory, yielding a 16 GB per-vCPU ratio. Its 260 MB L3 cache and hardware support for AMX and AVX-512 deliver top-tier memory bandwidth, achieving 391.59 GB/sec on uncached reads and 171.9 GB/sec on writes. Benchmark results reflect top-decile execution in database operations, image processing, and multi-threaded compilation. Because the server includes zero local ephemeral storage, external Premium Storage must be attached for all disk I/O. The constrained vCPU-to-memory configuration delivers qualitative cost efficiency for per-core licensed database software, making it a strong platform for large relational databases, distributed in-memory caches, and enterprise analytics.
